timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone name (for example America/New_York). Used for timestamps, the local date for workday/holiday checks, and when hourly greetings fire

injectEnvironmentPerception.title: Add environment awareness to the LLM
injectEnvironmentPerception.description: Before the last user message of every LLM call, adds [Sent at: … | weekday, workday/holiday/make-up workday, time of day], so the model knows the situation like LLMPerception

enableHolidayPerception.title: Enable Chinese holidays and make-up workdays
enableHolidayPerception.description: Needs chinese-workday (run npm install in the plugin folder). When off, only Monday to Friday vs. weekend is used

holidayCountry.title: Holiday region code
holidayCountry.description: Only CN uses the official holiday data. Other values fall back to weekend checks only

greetingHours.title: Greeting hours
greetingHours.description: Hours when she greets you (24-hour clock, comma separated, in the time zone above)

quietThreshold.title: Quiet threshold (minutes)
quietThreshold.description: If there has been no interaction for longer than this, she greets you right away

activeThreshold.title: Active threshold (minutes)
activeThreshold.description: If the last interaction was more recent than this, the chat counts as active and a prompt is added instead

deferTimeout.title: Wait timeout (minutes)
deferTimeout.description: How long to wait in a half-active chat. After that, this greeting is skipped

checkInterval.title: Time check interval (seconds)
checkInterval.description: How many seconds between checks for greeting time
